newsitem.title: PUERTO RICO: Six dead, 20 injured in Puerto Rico explosion.
newsitem.headline: Six dead, 20 injured in Puerto Rico explosion.

text.p: At least six people were killed and 20 injured early on Thursday in an explosion at a shoe store in the Rio Piedras neighbourhood of San Juan, police said.
An aide to Governor Pedro Rosello said a gas leak was suspected as the cause of the blast.
Reports on local radio said the death toll had risen to 12, but police could not immediately confirm that figure.

"We do know there was a San Juan Gas truck there," said Rosello's press aide, Juan Carlos Molina. "We suspect that it's related to a gas leak but that is still not confirmed. It was a rather large explosion."
Police spokesman Ramon Rodriguez said the store was in commercial shopping area near a crowded plaza that served as a an informal terminal for commuter vans.
Stores up to 220 yards (200 metres) away had their glass shattered by the explosion.
